transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, and I'm here to help with any questions you have about your cataract surgery recovery. How are you feeling after your surgery? Do you have any questions about your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! I'm doing alright, thank you for asking. I do have a few questions about my recovery. First, I'm wondering, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light gardening, like watering plants or doing some gentle weeding, after about 1 week after your surgery. However, it's best to avoid anything too strenuous or heavy lifting for a month. Would you like to know more about exercising after surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information, that helps. Another thing I was wondering is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should have been using preservative-free eye drops four times daily since your surgery. If you're running out, you can get more from your GP. Keep using them as prescribed to help with any dryness or discomfort.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thanks for that. I'm also experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Mild sensitivity to bright light is quite common after cataract surgery. If it's severe or you're experiencing significant pain, we may need to assess it further. Otherwise, just wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'll try that out, thank you. Lastly, I wanted to ask, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for vision to take a little time to settle after surgery, but if your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurry, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay. If you've only had one eye done, it's also normal to have a bit of imbalance, which should improve once your other eye is done. Would you like to know more about when to get your vision checked?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I don't have any more questions at the moment. I appreciate your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. I'm glad I could answer your questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Now that I've helped with all your questions, I just want to confirm: have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again for your help!

verdict.label: pass
